fitted_on.note: yes/no answers inside (0.2, 0.8) are moved to the floor on their own side (JevBench abstention rule)

reasoning.note: second pass for unsure choice questions (serve.py --reason): the base model writes a two-sentence rationale ending in 'Answer:', the letters are read after it and mixed 50/50 with the one-pass distribution at temperature 3; gate, weight and temperature chosen on OpenDecisions hard (167 of the 216 items below 0.9 are reasoned at gate 0.8), JevBench public and the sealed-set replica. max_seconds budgets the whole decision (first readout included) on the serving GPU and min_new_tokens is the smallest rationale worth starting; the budget keeps the pooled extra cost under the Jev-class cap
